nodes.description: Owner address of the Reputation contract, assigned from msg.sender in the constructor.
mapping(address=>bool) of accounts authorized to modify reputation ratings.
mapping(address=>int) storing the (possibly negative) reputation score of each user.
Deploy-time constructor that sets owner = msg.sender.
Owner-only function that whitelists a contract address so it may change ratings.
Whitelisted-only function that adds a signed delta to a user's rating.
view function returning the caller's own rating.
view function returning the rating of an arbitrary address.
Address passed to addToWhitelist that becomes whitelisted.
Address whose rating is adjusted in change(); also the key used in Reputation.get().
Signed integer delta applied to a user rating; unbounded caller-controlled value.
Unchecked signed arithmetic statement 'ratings[_userAddress] += _delta' with no overflow/underflow guard such as SafeMath.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow assert.
SafeMath division (Solidity reverts on division by zero).
SafeMath subtraction with underflow assert.
SafeMath addition with overflow assert; used for SafeTime arithmetic in EthToSmthSwaps.
Public owner address of the swap contract, set from msg.sender at deployment.
Address of the Reputation contract used for external reputation updates; owner-settable.
Constant timeout window (1 hour) used for atomic swap expiry checks.
Nested mapping (ETH owner => BTC owner => Swap) holding secret hash, creation time and locked balance.
Nested mapping storing the sign timestamp of a participant for swap initiation.
Deploy-time constructor setting owner = msg.sender.
Owner-only setter for the reputation contract address that will be externally called.
ETH owner signs a swap and records the current timestamp for the participant.
view function returning the recorded sign timestamp of an owner for the caller.
payable function locking ETH with a secret hash within the SafeTime window after signing.
view function returning the locked balance of an ETH owner relative to the caller.
BTC owner reveals the secret, receives the ETH and updates reputation; performs external call and transfer before clearing state.
view function returning the stored secret of an ETH owner for the caller.
ETH owner closes a swap after it was withdrawn, gaining reputation and cleaning state.
ETH owner refunds after the timeout, transferring ETH to itself and penalizing the counterparty reputation.
BTC owner aborts a swap when the ETH owner failed to create it in time, penalizing the ETH owner.
Internal helper deleting both the swap entry and the participant sign entry.
Owner-only alpha backdoor that transfers an arbitrary ETH amount out of the contract.
External caller address used for authorization, mapping keys and ETH transfers.
Block timestamp ('now') used for swap timing, sign validity and refund/abort expiry checks.
'msg.sender.transfer(swap.balance)' executed in withdraw() before the swap state is zeroed.
'msg.sender.transfer(swap.balance)' executed in refund() before the swap state is cleaned.
'owner.transfer(amount)' in withdr(): owner-only arbitrary withdrawal of contract ETH.
External callback 'Reputation(ratingContractAddress).change(...)' to an owner-controlled contract address, invoked from withdraw/close/refund/abort.
New reputation contract address supplied by the owner.
Counterparty address whose sign timestamp is recorded.
ETH owner address whose sign timestamp is queried.
ripemd160 commitment of the swap secret stored in the Swap struct.
Counterparty address of the created swap.
ETH owner address whose locked balance is queried.
Preimage secret revealed by the BTC owner to claim the swap.
ETH owner address whose swap is being withdrawn.
Counterparty address whose secret is queried.
Counterparty address of the swap being closed.
Counterparty address penalized and cleaned on refund.
ETH owner address penalized by the abort.
ETH owner key of the swap/participantSigns entries to delete.
Counterparty key of the swap/participantSigns entries to delete.
Arbitrary ETH amount the owner drains through withdr().
'Swap memory swap' copy loaded from swaps[_ownerAddress][msg.sender] in withdraw().
'Swap memory swap' copy loaded from swaps[msg.sender][_participantAddress] in refund().
Address whose rating is read in Reputation.get().

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable inside the Reputation constructor.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
msg.sender is compared against owner as the only authorization check of addToWhitelist.
addToWhitelist reads the owner state variable for the require check.
The supplied address parameter is written into the whitelist mapping.
addToWhitelist writes the whitelist mapping entry.
msg.sender indexes whitelist in change() to authorize the caller.
change reads the whitelist mapping for the authorization check.
The user address parameter is used as the rating mapping key in change().
The delta parameter is consumed by the rating update statement in change().
change() contains the unchecked signed arithmetic operation on ratings.
Caller-controlled _delta flows directly into the unchecked 'ratings[_userAddress] += _delta' operation.
The unchecked addition writes the ratings state variable, allowing overflow/underflow of the stored score.
getMy reads the ratings mapping for the caller.
msg.sender is used as the ratings mapping key in getMy.
get reads the ratings mapping for an arbitrary address.
The queried address parameter is supplied to Reputation.get.
The address parameter indexes the ratings mapping inside get().
msg.sender becomes the swap contract owner in its constructor.
The swap contract constructor writes the owner state variable.
msg.sender is compared with owner in setReputationAddress.
setReputationAddress reads the owner state variable for authorization.
The owner-supplied address parameter is validated then stored.
setReputationAddress writes the owner-controlled ratingContractAddress used for external calls.
msg.sender is the swap owner key updated in sign().
The participant address parameter is used as the second mapping key in sign().
The stored participant sign timestamp is taken directly from the manipulable block timestamp ('now').
sign writes participantSigns[msg.sender][_participantAddress] = now.
sign reads the swaps mapping to ensure no deposit is currently locked.
The owner address parameter is used as the first mapping key in checkSign.
msg.sender is used as the second mapping key in checkSign.
checkSign reads the participantSigns mapping.
The secret hash parameter is stored in the new Swap struct.
The participant address parameter indexes the swaps and participantSigns mappings.
msg.sender is the ETH owner key of the created swap.
createSwap compares the current block timestamp with the stored sign time, making timing depend on miner-controlled 'now'.
The SafeTime constant participates in the sign-window timestamp check.
createSwap reads the participant sign timestamp of the counterparty.
createSwap stores the new Swap (secret hash, createdAt=now, msg.value) in the swaps mapping.
The owner address parameter indexes the swaps mapping in getBalance.
msg.sender is used as the participant key in getBalance.
getBalance reads the swaps mapping.
The revealed secret parameter is hashed and compared with the stored secret hash.
The owner address parameter indexes the swaps mapping in withdraw.
msg.sender is the participant key and the receiver of the ETH transfer in withdraw.
withdraw reads the Swap struct from the swaps mapping.
withdraw validates swap expiry against the manipulable block timestamp.
SafeTime is added to createdAt in the withdraw expiry check.
withdraw loads the swap into the local memory variable.
withdraw performs the external ETH transfer before clearing the swap balance.
The ETH transfer sends value to the untrusted msg.sender, enabling a fallback reentrancy.
The untrusted recipient can re-enter withdraw() through its fallback before swaps[..].balance is zeroed.
withdraw makes an external call to the owner-controlled reputation contract before state cleanup.
withdraw zeroes the swap balance and stores the revealed secret only after the transfers.
The participant address parameter indexes the swaps mapping in getSecret.
msg.sender is used as the ETH owner key in getSecret.
getSecret reads the swaps mapping.
The participant address parameter indexes the swaps mapping in close.
msg.sender is the ETH owner key in close.
close reads the swaps mapping to check the balance is zero.
close makes an external call into the reputation contract to award reputation.
close invokes the internal clean helper.
The participant address parameter indexes the swaps mapping and is penalized in refund.
msg.sender is the ETH owner key and the refund recipient.
refund reads the Swap struct from the swaps mapping.
refund compares block.timestamp against createdAt plus SafeTime to authorize the refund.
SafeTime is added to createdAt in the refund expiry check.
refund loads the swap into the local memory variable.
refund performs the external ETH transfer before cleaning the swap state.
The refund transfer sends ETH to the untrusted msg.sender.
The untrusted recipient's fallback can re-enter refund() before clean() deletes the swap.
refund calls the owner-controlled reputation contract before cleaning the swap state.
refund invokes the internal clean helper.
The owner address parameter indexes the swaps and participantSigns mappings in abort.
msg.sender is the BTC owner key in abort.
abort reads the swaps mapping to check the balance.
abort reads the recorded sign timestamp of the ETH owner.
abort relies on block.timestamp plus SafeTime to decide whether the ETH owner missed the deadline.
SafeTime is added to the participant sign timestamp in abort.
abort makes an external call into the reputation contract to penalize the ETH owner.
abort invokes the internal clean helper.
The owner address parameter is the first key deleted in clean.
The participant address parameter is the second key deleted in clean.
clean deletes the swaps mapping entry.
clean deletes the participantSigns mapping entry.
The caller-provided amount flows into the owner withdrawal in withdr.
msg.sender is compared with owner as the only guard of withdr.
withdr reads the owner state variable for its authorization check.
withdr lets the owner drain an arbitrary amount of contract ETH; the unreleased backdoor is a privileged fund-removal path.
The swap contract externally invokes Reputation.change, so a malicious owner-controlled reputation contract can re-enter before swap state is cleaned.
